flash_692127.description: Prime Minister speaks with the singer during her concert: “It’s wonderful to be with our amazing people and with you."

flash_692129.description: Albany woman charged after allegedly plotting an ISIS-inspired attack on New York's Capitol and seeking explosives and a gun.

flash_692128.description:
Hapoel Tel Aviv on Thursday evening played to a 0-0 draw away to Italian side Atalanta in Bergamo in the first leg of the Conference League playoff round.

Meanwhile, Maccabi Tel Aviv lost 2-1 to Lugano in Switzerland and will need to win the second leg next week to overturn the deficit and advance to the league phase of the competition.

flash_692131.description: Some 50,000 people attend second Selichot service at the Western Wall, praying for the safety of IDF soldiers and the security of Israel.

flash_692130.description:
Dozens of extremist haredim protested at the Maccabim Checkpoint near Modi’in, in protest of the arrest of a draft evader.

The evader was detained by police near the Beit Gamzu Junction and was later transferred to Military Police custody.

flash_692136.description: The US imposes new sanctions on Hezbollah over its ties to Iran's Quds Force and sanctions 10 people accused of helping move cash for the Lebanese terror group.

flash_692135.description:
Lebanese media reported early Friday morning that the Israel Air Force carried out strikes in the town of Mansouri and in the Ali al-Taher ridge area in southern Lebanon.

Later, two additional strikes were reported in Duhayra and Kfar Rouman in southern Lebanon.

flash_692133.description: Jay Shapiro examines the unique continuity of the Jewish nation, its connection to Jerusalem, and the persistence of antisemitism throughout history.

flash_692141.description: The Trump administration plans to again bar PA chairman Mahmoud Abbas from entering the US for the UN General Assembly, Israeli media reports.

flash_692140.description: Finding holiness where you least expect it.

flash_692139.description: The war of conquest against the West involves both Iran and the Muslim Brotherhood. Opinion.

flash_692138.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is currently holding discussions ahead of the appointment of a new interior minister and is expected to make a decision soon, following nearly a year in which the ministry has operated without a permanent minister. Kan 11 News reported.

According to the report, the appointment will be coordinated with Shas chairman Aryeh Deri, who is expected to approve only a candidate acceptable to him. Leading candidates include Coalition Chairman Ofir Katz, Ministers Miki Zohar and Yariv Levin, and Interior Ministry Director-General Israel Ouzan.

flash_692137.description: The EU is preparing sanctions against Israel if construction proceeds in E1, including possible trade, academic, security and diplomatic measures.

flash_692134.description:
A terrorist armed with a knife attempted to stab an IDF soldier during IDF operational activity in the Jenin area.

The soldiers responded by firing toward the terrorist and eliminating him. No IDF injuries were reported.

flash_692132.description:
Italian media reported that 45 kilograms of smoke grenades and fireworks were found in the rented apartment of two Hapoel Tel Aviv fans who were arrested shortly before the team’s match in Bergamo.

According to the reports, Italian special forces and intelligence officers took part in the raid on the apartment.

flash_692144.description: Here comes Elul: Primal urges or the spirit of prophecy?

flash_692143.description: US Vice President JD Vance says the Iran war has entered a new phase, with Washington relying on economic pressure to prevent Tehran from rebuilding.

flash_692145.description: Yashar! surges to 26 seats as Likud falls to 20, while the center-left bloc reaches 60 seats, just one short of a Knesset majority.

flash_692147.description: Family, friends and fellow yeshiva students gather to accompany Yehuda Yekutiel Katz to his final resting place, 44 years after he went missing in the Battle of Sultan Yacoub.

flash_692146.description: Passengers face major delays, hours-long baggage waits, as fallout from the airport strike continues into Friday morning.

flash_692142.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul urges Mayor Zohran Mamdani to focus on city government rather than Israel amid concerns over his anti-Israel rhetoric.

flash_692148.description: Solomon's Pools takes a major step toward opening to the public, offering visitors a rare look at the ancient system that supplied Jerusalem during the Second Temple period.

flash_692154.description: Turkey under Erdogan is not a democratic bridge between East and West, nor is it a reliable pillar of transatlantic security; it is an expansionist, authoritarian power fundamentally hostile to democratic governance, Western values, and the existence of Israel in the Middle East. Another wake up call. Opinion.

flash_692153.description: 'Democrats' MK Gilad Kariv says party not competing with Arab parties for voters, insists strong Arab representation important for Israeli democracy.

flash_692152.description: Developments suggest that Turkey is gradually acquiring the ability to project naval power across two strategically important maritime theaters: the Mediterranean and the Red Sea. Israel must plan its next steps. Opinion.

flash_692151.description: Hamas commander Sabahi Sami Mahmoud Shahata, who participated in the October 7 massacre and held multiple hostages in captivity, eliminated in IDF strike in Nuseirat.

flash_692150.description: The manner in which we confront the wiles of the yetser ha’ra in its efforts to subvert our avodat Hashem, is the true measure of our service of our Creator.

flash_692149.description: Police reveal the identity of 26-year-old man suspected of stabbing two young cousins as they played in a pool, killing seven-year-old Hillel Mordechai Dadon.

flash_692157.description:
A group of Jews touring in eastern Gush Etzion entered an Arab village a short time ago, and was attacked with rocks.

IDF forces were called to the scene to extract the hikers.

flash_692156.description: Joint Arab List leaders meet European Union ambassadors in Tel Aviv, urging greater European involvement in Israel and presenting allegations over government policy and Arab representation.

flash_692159.description: Dozens of Arab rioters hurl rocks at Jewish hikers who apparently entered village by mistake; security forces rush to rescue the group.

flash_692158.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan defends party's 'massive campaign' targeting Arab voters, vowing Jews and Arabs will work together to replace government.

flash_692155.description: Dealing with children who derail your life.

flash_692163.description: Isaiah’s message was one of consolation, but also of responsibility.

flash_692162.description: We are not just a united nation. We are a nation of one, so interconnected that we are like a single person. A look at the parasha's topics shows it.

flash_692161.description: Is this a bad or a good thing? And who is behind the initiative? Some are against the idea of flying in to vote and leaving again, some are afraid there is only one type of voter being helped to fly in to vote.

flash_692160.description: Former Prime Minister calls illegal weapons a top-level security threat and proposes deploying the Shin Bet to locate and seize them.

flash_692166.description: Following an incident in which the owner of the Taurus Smokehouse in Savyon was attacked over blowing a shofar, activists from the Noam Yisrael party came to show their support.

flash_692165.description: Lahav 433, Tax Authority, uncover drone import network allegedly used for weapons and drug smuggling.

flash_692164.description: Days after Israeli flags were vandalized near Rawabi, activists restore them and add dozens more: 'For every flag that was vandalized, we put up another.'

flash_692169.description:
Several people were injured in an attack at a school in Sweden by a man armed with a sword, according to local media reports.

Further details about the circumstances of the incident have not yet been released.

flash_692168.description: Ankara asks Interpol to issue arrest warrants for Netanyahu and dozens of senior Israeli officials over their alleged involvement in stopping the Global Sumud flotilla en route to Gaza.

flash_692167.description:
The Israel Airports Authority announced that operations at Ben Gurion Airport have stabilized and returned to normal. The flight schedule is operating as usual, and terminal operations are taking place without delays.

Luggage that had not been sent abroad has been sorted and transferred to the airlines, while baggage belonging to passengers who landed but did not receive it is being delivered to them by the airlines.

flash_692173.description: What is chutzpah? A Jew pouring a foundation in his ancestral homeland who gets a summons, a sanctions package, a joint communiqué with six other governments and a threat to label his tomatoes. Opinion.

flash_692172.description:
An individual who, according to the IDF, crossed the yellow line in southern Gaza and approached Israeli troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat was neutralized by soldiers from the Givati Brigade.

The IDF said Southern Command forces remain deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue operating to eliminate any immediate threats.

flash_692171.description: What was wrong with the Moabites and the Ammonites?

flash_692170.description: Escalation in draft battle: Yeshiva student arrested, clashes erupt at Maccabim checkpoint.

flash_692176.description: '20 rabbis asked Netanyahu to hold prayer inside Gaza. We are returning to the parts of the Land that we abandoned. We did it in northern Samaria, and we will do it in Gaza as well,' says Minister Orit Strock.

flash_692175.description: My father, the Rav HaNazir, and Rav Tzvi Yehudah were of the opinion that everyone is obligated to go out and fight. This was a milhemet mitzvah, a compulsory war, in which all are expected to participate.

flash_692174.description: The Prime Minister’s Office responded to Turkey’s request to issue a “Red Notice" against Netanyahu “for genocide," stating: “Israel has long since ceased to be impressed by Turkey’s hypocrisy. Erdogan is an antisemitic dictator who massacred Kurds, supports the massacre carried out by the Hamas terrorist organization, and oppresses his own people."

flash_692177.description:
IDF troops in central Gaza detain a Hamas terrorist armed with a knife after he crossed the Yellow Line and entered Israeli territory for questioning.

Israel's Artem Dolgopyat wins his third European title in floor exercise, adding another gold to an Olympic and World Championship medal-filled career.

Sword attack at a school in central Sweden leaves one dead and at least three wounded. Suspect arrested.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

Britain, Canada and Australia condemn Israel's decision not to pursue criminal probes over the 2024 deaths in Gaza of seven World Central Kitchen aid workers.

President Trump says military action against Iran remains an option: They would love a deal but are not ready to make the right one.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:53 Jerusalem time.

flash_692186.description:
Liberman says the opposition must shift five to six seats away from the coalition, increase voter turnout and allow each party to maximize its electoral strength.

Five Palestine Action activists convicted of causing £200,000 in damage at a Barclays branch will not receive terrorist sentences.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_692188.description: The 28th national conference of Ra’am opened today (Saturday) in Tayibe, with the participation of approximately 1,050 party members, men and women, from across Arab society

flash_692187.description: Defense Minister claims Israel warned the Syrian regime in advance against an attempt to allow Turkey to establish a presence at the Abu al-Duhur airbase.

flash_692193.description: A man in his 70s collapsed during a sporting activity near Delilah Beach in Ashkelon. The MDA provided medical treatment and performed CPR, as well as defibrillating him. His pulse returned, and he was evacuated to Barzlai Hospital.

flash_692192.description:
The IDF eliminated the terrorist Sharif al-Hasanat, a company commander in the military wing of Hamas earlier today in the Deir al-Balah area .

"The terrorist posed an immediate threat to our forces. Throughout the war, the terrorist took part in the restoration of Hamas' underground infrastructure. Recenly, he continued to try to promote terror against IDF forces and Israeli citizens," the IDF claimed.

flash_692190.description: The Israel Airports Authority workers' committee warns that there is a shortage of between 400 and 500 workers in all departments. According to him, the shortage directly affects the service to passengers and is likely to be felt especially during the holiday rush.

flash_692196.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, this evening send congratulations to Artem Dolgopyat for his gold medal in the European gymnastics championship. “Congratulations to the three-time European Gymnastics Championship floor exercise champion, Artem Dolgopyat. Artem, you bring immense honor and national pride to the State of Israel, time and time again."

flash_692195.description: Paramount Pictures accuses Hulk actor of using antisemitic tropes after he attacks the Ellison family and Israel in a rant against the planned merger with Warner Brothers.

flash_692191.description: At least seven kites have been found in the Gaza border area since October 7. The IDF has not yet determined that they originated in the Gaza Strip, but regional councils are demanding a real-time response.

flash_692189.description:
The 28th national conference of the United Arab List, held in Tayibe, has chosen the party list for the upcoming elections. Mansour Abbas was elected first, and will head the list.

After him, in order, were elected Walid Taha, Waleed Khalil Alhwashla, Iman Khatib-Yassin (in the fourth place, reserved for women), and Yasir Hujeirat.

flash_692199.description: Firefighting crews, together with the IDF, are operating at the scene. Police have blocked access routes. Heavy engineering equipment was brought into the flames to isolate vehicles that have not yet burned.

flash_692198.description: How are we to determine the ideal forms of behavior?

flash_692197.description: An experience is also a picture. You stand before it and gaze back at it, and the date is in the past.

flash_692194.description: Ben Gurion Airport could face renewed disruptions as Israel Airports Authority union chairman Pinchas Idan refuses to guarantee the crisis is over and blames management for the airport’s manpower shortage.

flash_692202.description: Following an Air Force investigation into the October 7 massacre, Squadron 190 has relocated north as the IDF seeks faster response times and greater readiness along Israel’s northern border.

flash_692201.description: The rise of the Democratic Socialists of America and its alliance with Radical Islam. Opinion.

flash_692200.description: US President Donald Trump has opened a new front against conservative media personality Tucker Carlson and former members of Congress Marjorie Taylor Greene and Thomas Massie.

flash_692203.description: Tens of thousands attend Selichot service at the Western Wall, joined by hostage survivors who recite a special prayer of thanksgiving for their return.

flash_692206.description:
Lebanese media reported that the IDF carried out an early morning strike in southern Lebanon.

According to the report, the strike took place in the Ali Taher ridge area.

flash_692205.description: Israel’s defense establishment is closely monitoring the public exchange of threats between Jerusalem and Ankara, warning that tensions could undermine the IDF’s freedom of action in Syria.

flash_692211.description: The Vice President’s words and actions--the hard evidence--are what makes him a dangerous choice for President of the United States. Opinion.

flash_692210.description: Education prioritizes responsibility over self-interest, connects learning to lived action and insists that Torah is not just something to study, but something to live.

flash_692209.description: Toronto man charged after allegedly breaking into a North York synagogue and stealing religious items. Police later recovered the items.

flash_692207.description: Footage: Effigies of Trump and Netanyahu hung in Tehran’s Revolution Square

flash_692204.description: The Telegraph reports that Iran-linked hackers shut down a small British power plant for four days in an unprecedented cyberattack.

flash_692214.description: Hamas is pressuring mediators to issue a statement against Israel. Security forces express concern over kites sent toward the Gaza border.

flash_692213.description: Israeli defense official says Israel does not seek conflict with Turkey but will act to prevent Turkish military systems in Syria from threatening Israel.

flash_692212.description: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu criticizes the Yanuka and the enthusiasm surrounding him, arguing that he is unlike the Baba Sali and other righteous figures he knew.

flash_692208.description: Iran warns countries against joining Trump's economic campaign, threatening confrontation and saying the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed.

flash_692218.description: Suspected stabbing attack near Al-Auja north of Jericho

flash_692217.description: A Shas campaign video showing one son serving in the IDF and another studying in yeshiva sparks sharp online reactions, with users pointing to the party’s push for haredi draft exemptions.

flash_692215.description:
National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir claimed that two of the three people reported killed overnight during criminal clashes in Jerusalem's Silwan neighborhood had thrown stones and firebombs and were shot by police during the incident.

He said that portraying them as “murder victims" amounts to “social engineering."

flash_692225.description: Footage from Jordan Valley stabbing: Terrorist stakes out victim and pounces from behind

flash_692224.description: Report: One killed, several injured, in Israeli drone strike in central Gaza Strip

flash_692223.description:
Border Police officers arrested two residents of Kafr Aqab on suspicion of attempting to carve an opening at the base of the security barrier using electric power tools, with the aim of creating a passage from Judea and Samaria into Israel.

According to police, the two attempted to flee but were located after a brief chase inside a nearby residential building. A large drill and electrical cables allegedly used by the suspects were seized at the scene.

flash_692222.description: Additional kite, apparently from Gaza, found in Kibbutz Kfar Aza

flash_692221.description: According to initial details of the incident, the Jewish victim entered the village to go shopping. The assailant has fled.

flash_692220.description: More than 100 former British and French diplomats sign letter to French President Macron and UK Prime Minister Burnham, calling for a boycott of Israel, 'Palestine is being erased before our eyes.'

flash_692219.description: A cigarette-smoking orangutan at Ramat Gan Safari has gone viral.

flash_692216.description: Iran executes Majid Adineh, arrested during January protests and sentenced to death on charges including alleged actions in favor of Israel and the US.

flash_692228.description: A Jewish woman claims that a taxi driver in Warsaw began yelling at her, pulled out a Quran and yelled 'Allahu Akbar,' after noticing the Star of David she wore around her neck.

flash_692227.description: Jordan Valley attack: Hospital reports victim in stable condition, fully conscious

flash_692226.description: Israeli-French singer Amir Haddad says a mezuzah was torn from his Paris home, calling the incident a sign of rising antisemitism in France.

flash_692230.description:
Jonathan Pollard announces he is joining Israel First, led by MK Sharren Haskel, and will support the party in Israel’s upcoming elections.

Read more.

flash_692229.description: Two days after chaos at Ben Gurion Airport, the Airports Authority moves against union chairman Pinchas Idan and seeks review of his term extension.

flash_692233.description: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani says talks with Israel may resume soon, as Damascus seeks a security deal and an end to Israeli strikes.

flash_692232.description: 'The absurdity is glaring: The state is planning a strategic community with one hand, while allowing the Palestinian Authority to thwart it with the other,' petitions Regavim.

flash_692231.description:
Detectives from the Border Police Coastal District Central Unit, Border Police officers in Judea and Samaria, and Israel Nature and Parks Authority inspectors located a young Israeli gazelle overnight in the village of A-Ram. The gazelle is a protected wild animal that may not legally be hunted or kept in captivity.

The animal was transferred for further treatment to the wildlife hospital at the Ramat Gan Safari.

A 48-year-old resident of Kafr Aqab was detained for questioning on suspicion of illegally trading in, possessing, and hunting a protected natural asset.

flash_692236.description: An intruder broke into the Knesset compound overnight and managed to enter the building. He was caught sitting near the office of Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana.

flash_692235.description: Arab reports of an Israeli airstrike in central Gaza

flash_692234.description: Elchanan, a career IDF soldier, was traveling with his pregnant wife when he stopped to buy cigarettes and was stabbed three times by a terrorist. His condition has stabilized, and he is expected to undergo surgery.

flash_692241.description: הטלית של אלחנן מגואלת בדםצילום: ערוץ 7

flash_692240.description: Central Elections Committee chairman orders Shas and Aryeh Deri to remove a video featuring a religious soldier. The decision followed a petition by Eisenkot’s party.

flash_692238.description: Central Elections Committee Chair Sohlberg orders Shas to remove campaign video depicting soldier

flash_692237.description: We are. Dark forces infiltrate every breach in the USA, widening them through chaos, migration and party infiltration until power concentrates in the hands of a few and there is no way back to the gardens that grew its distinct beauty. Opinion.

flash_692242.description: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu, Chief Rabbi of Tzfat, stated 'We are working on building a synagogue on the Temple Mount.'

flash_692245.description:
A short while ago, a report was received regarding an attempt by a terrorist to steal a weapon from an IDF soldier in the area of Rimonim Square.

The soldier fired toward the terrorist, who was neutralized. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the scene

flash_692244.description: Meir Ben Shitrit is furious over reports of a plea deal with Yifat Tomer-Yerushalmi: “This time you will not whitewash the Force 100 affair."

flash_692239.description: No regime change has taken place in Tehran. America’s longtime enemies and veterans of the Islamic Republic’s machinery of violence are back at the commanding heights of power-and Iran is entering a new age of hard-line rule. Opinion.

flash_692247.description: The 16-year-old terrorist who stabbed and moderately wounded Elhcanan Hanania was captured following an IDF manhunt in the village of al-Auja, where he carried out the attack.

flash_692246.description: Prime Minister addresses the developing threat of explosive drones on the southern front in a special video. “I have instructed that everything be done against these deadly devices."

flash_692243.description: In an attack by an Arab gang during the Great Arab Revolt on the home of the Lazarevich family, members of the family were kidnapped; the three adults were murdered, and the children were released.

flash_692249.description: A known criminal, approximately 45 years old, was shot at a gas station near Caesarea and critically wounded. He later died of his wounds. Police have opened an investigation.

flash_692248.description: Earlier today, the IDF and the ISA struck in the Maghazi area in the Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Ismail Abu Ful, a commander at a weapons manufacturing site within Hamas’ production headquarters.

flash_692251.description: Netanyahu warns Hamas that continued drone, kite and balloon launches from Gaza will trigger intensified IDF action, including strikes on launch sites and operators.

flash_692250.description: A rare meeting was held between Mossad Director Roman Gofman and Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani in an effort to ease tensions and prevent a security escalation.

flash_692253.description: Jared Kushner reportedly met Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Cairo after US intelligence indicated that some Hamas officials were planning to violate commitments to disarm.

flash_692252.description: A new poll puts Gadi Eisenkot ahead of Likud, while the anti-Netanyahu bloc leads the right by six seats - and a new political contender could widen the gap.

flash_692256.description: Peace becomes impossible when a public culture rewards the sacrifice of children more than the protection of their future. Opinion.

flash_692255.description: Israeli YouTube users are about to pay more, with Premium subscriptions rising by roughly 25% and YouTube Music also getting a price increase.

flash_692254.description: A Polish citizen ordered 300 pizzas to the homes of local residents and politicians while impersonating them.

flash_692258.description: Foreign Minister Sa’ar asks the Population and Immigration Authority to prevent entry to Swedish lawmakers who were scheduled to land in Israel en route to the Palestinian Authority.

flash_692257.description: Muay Thai and kickboxing fighter Ahavat Hashem Gordon marries Oren Levy in Hadera.

flash_692259.description:
The Civil Administration rescued three Israelis in recent hours after they entered areas under Palestinian Authority control: an armed Jewish man who accidentally entered the village of Ein Arik in the Binyamin region, a Jewish woman who deliberately entered Jericho, and an Israeli described as being in an unstable mental state who was spotted in the streets of Bethlehem.

The Civil Administration stressed: “Entering Area A is life-threatening and prohibited by law."

flash_692262.description: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas condemns Israel's E1 construction plans, saying the project would undermine prospects for a two-state solution.

flash_692261.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed the issue of security for Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot and instructed Shin Bet (Israel Security Agency) Director David Zini to ensure that Eisenkot receives security “at an adequate level, as needed."

The Shin Bet told Netanyahu that it is “doing everything possible" and is “acting in accordance with the law."

flash_692260.description: US envoy Tom Barrack walks back remarks that Israel “still" occupies the Golan Heights, stressing that Trump's 2019 recognition remains US policy.
